  get filteredProducts(): Product[] {
    return this.products.filter(prod => {
      const matchSearch =
        this.searchText === '' || prod.name.toLowerCase().includes(this.searchText.toLowerCase());
      const matchFilter =
        this.selectedFilterRadioButton === 'all' ||
        (this.selectedFilterRadioButton === 'inStock' && prod.is_in_inventory) ||
        (this.selectedFilterRadioButton === 'outOfStock' && !prod.is_in_inventory);

      return matchSearch && matchFilter;
    });
  }

<!-- Filter Component -->
<app-filter
  [all]="totalProductsCount"
  [inStock]="productInStock"
  [outOfstock]="productOutOfStock"
  (productSelectedButtonChanged)="onFilterChanged($event)">
</app-filter>

<!-- Product Grid -->
<div class="ekart--products--container">
  <ng-container *ngFor="let prod of filteredProducts">
    <app-product
      class="ekart--product--card"
      [product]="prod"
      (click)="viewProduct(prod)">
    </app-product>
  </ng-container>
</div>
